purpose: Blinded, rights-reviewed staging evaluation of trichome detection and maturity classification. This template contains no accuracy evidence.

eligibilityPolicy.note: These are initial staging-eligibility floors, not a claim of accuracy or scientific validation. The same blinded set must score the deployed baseline and candidate.

annotationRules.boxCoordinates: Normalized x, y, width, and height in the untouched source image.
annotationRules.countOnly: Resolved intact gland heads in identified calyx regions.
annotationRules.review: Two independent labels followed by adjudication. Preserve disagreements; do not tune labels to a model result or an expected harvest date.
